title: Exclude test definitions outside allowed automation
preconditions: Use separate fixtures for each nonempty subset of manual, hybrid and automated; otherwise identical linked cases differ only in automation.

steps.action: Apply each allowed-automation subset and inspect every case variant, including a manual-only policy.
steps.expected_result: Allowed modes may cover the criterion; excluded modes report automation not allowed and cannot satisfy it.

expected_result: Exclude test definitions outside allowed automation.
